ideas.text: Schedule the daily db:cleanup as a Vercel cron instead of a manual script
Make the book cover and table of contents follow the uploaded book version
Publish a one-page owner split (us, admin group, committee) to share with the admin group
Add backup mobile and village/center fields to the registration form (database columns already exist).
Replace the generic Ministry of Education logo with the Eastern Province education directorate logo.
Rename the leftover 'الجهات المشاركة' nav links to match the new section title.
Swap the logo sides if the user's sketch puts the two partners on the right
Offer KFUPM's bilingual 2023 lockup as an alternative to the current English wordmark
Add 'فهرس المصادر والمراجع' (printed p.57) to the book reader's contents list.
Hardcode the 12 Eastern Province cities in the registration dropdown, keeping server validation in sync.
Add a 'للاطلاع على شروط المشاركة ومعايير التقييم' link from the prizes section to /terms.
Add a replace-migration so saved site_content picks up the new hero subtitle and award wording.
Add a Playwright check that public pages contain no Latin digits.
Make the stale-client registration payload (backup/village) fully rejected once cached forms expire.
Add more Eastern Province cities (الظهران, الهفوف, سيهات) to the default city list.
Run db:migrate automatically or add a pre-deploy check so a new migration cannot ship unapplied.

findings.text: Repository cleanup is saved locally on main. Push main and the preserved release tag, verify the exact Vercel production commit, then retire obsolete branches. The owner requested a safe stop; see the cleanup resume handover.
The supplied 75 questions are unapproved drafts. Committee reviewers must verify wording, keys and book/official sources before approval and freeze.
Privacy contact, minors procedure, retention, media/prize criteria, patronage and specialist release approvals remain pending; see the technical gap report.
Real SMS activation requires an approved organization account/sender and a successful recorded readiness test. Verify current provider configuration through Admin before activation.
Confirm current production storage, staff allowlists/MFA, least privilege, backups and incident procedures before real registration. Historical evidence does not prove present configuration.
Desktop, tablet and mobile emulation passed, but real iPhone/Android and production recovery/capacity exercises remain separate checks.
Correct answers and explanations are sent to participants after submission (competition-result.tsx), contradicting meeting note 1 and terms clause 8.
/terms still shows the old 15 rules, not the 25 dark clauses; data-protection clauses 15–25 are missing.
Hafr Al-Batin University logo has 'تجريبي' (beta) printed on it; KFUPM logo is English-only.
Clause 5 (all questions from the book) contradicts the 3 Presidency questions in each bank; the committee must decide
public/documents/participation-rules.pdf is the old 14-rule version and is still publicly reachable
The production database is disconnected (empty DATABASE_URL), so registration and the competition cannot work on the live site
Vercel posted no deployment or GitHub status for commit 58893d4, unlike earlier commits; the Git integration may not have triggered.
Production DATABASE_URL is still empty, so registration and participation can't work live; only the prizes fallback was added.
Committee decisions still pending: prize approval, media-award criteria, logo publication approval, patronage wording, clause 5 vs Presidency questions.
Production registration city list fails if DATABASE_URL is unset, so the form cannot load cities or register.
The city field shows the loading text forever on any fetch failure, hiding the real error state.
Last commit bd42b4d aligned the author name to the book cover; the document now asks to remove that name and the 'كتاب المسابقة' caption under the book.
Prize amounts, rank labels and FAQ question counts render in Latin digits via en-US formatting; the document asks for Arabic digits throughout the prizes page.
Backup phone and village/centre registration fields still exist in the form, validation, INSERT and admin display, although the document says they should not.
Migration 013 only replaces the exact old hero string; if the committee edited the saved hero text, production keeps the custom value.
Stale browser tests or fixtures may still assert Latin digits or old prize/registration strings beyond the ones grepped; they were not run.
Author name still appears in the /book page subtitle, cover alt text and about paragraph; scope was not confirmed.
Deploying a content-only migration makes every production API route return 503 until db:migrate is run; no deploy gate or ordering enforces this.
registration-options now falls back to open registration with default cities when the DB is down, which could show a paused or closed competition as open.
Author name still appears in the /book subtitle, cover alt text and about paragraph; the document asked only about the area under the book.
